pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Patches are predominantly polygonal with edges exhibiting smooth pixel gradients likely due to image resolution; individual dark regions on the flank are significantly larger in spatial area compared to the smaller, more densely packed patches visible on the neck and lower leg.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light pelage forms a continuous network of negative-space pathways with frequent three-way and four-way junction nodes; pixel thickness of these corridors is relatively uniform across the mid-section, while pathways on the neck show reduced thickness and increased density.
